Strategic Advisory

Decisive moments deserve experienced counsel.

We stand beside owners and boards when the stakes are highest — when a company changes hands, passes to a new generation, or needs to rebuild its financial structure.

Mergers & Acquisitions

Buy-side and sell-side advisory that turns a transaction into a lasting strategic advantage.

Valuation · Target screening · Due diligence coordination · Deal structuring · Negotiation · Post-merger integration

Generational Transition

Guiding family businesses through succession, protecting both the company's value and the family's legacy.

Succession planning · Family governance & charters · Ownership transfer · MBO / MBI · Next-generation readiness

Debt Restructuring

Restoring financial balance and giving sound businesses the room to grow again.

Liquidity & cash-flow analysis · Recovery business plans · Negotiation with banks & creditors · Refinancing · Turnaround

Deep-Tech Ventures

We promote the technologies that answer the century's hardest questions.

Water, clean energy and frontier engineering need patient capital and industrial know-how. We connect breakthrough founders with the investors, partners and markets that can scale them.

Deep High-Tech Start-ups

We scout and support science-based companies with defensible technology — from early validation through fundraising and industrial scale-up.

Scouting · Strategic mentoring · Fundraising · Go-to-market · Industrial partnerships

Air-to-Water Generators

Atmospheric water generation extracts clean drinking water directly from the humidity in the air — an independent source wherever pipelines, wells or rivers fall short.

Water-scarce regions · Off-grid communities · Emergency relief · Industry & agriculture · Hospitality

Hydrogen Technologies

Hydrogen is a cornerstone of the energy transition. We back solutions across the value chain that help decarbonise industry, mobility and power.

Green hydrogen production · Storage & distribution · Fuel cells · Industrial decarbonisation

Tokenization & Blockchain

Strategic assets, reimagined as digital ownership.

Tokenization turns real-world assets into secure, programmable digital units on a blockchain — opening access to new investors, improving liquidity and making ownership transparent and traceable.

Asset tokenization

Real estate, infrastructure, energy plants, commodities and intellectual property.

Blockchain strategy

Platform selection, token design and smart-contract architecture with trusted partners.

Regulatory alignment

Structures built to fit the applicable frameworks, including the EU's MiCA regulation.

Investor access

Fractional ownership and distribution to qualified investors.
